ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows three oblique blue lines marked with identical magenta arrow symbols, indicating the three oblique lines are parallel. A slanted blue transversal and a nearly vertical blue transversal intersect these parallel lines. The upper intersection includes angles labeled (7x+9)° and (7y-4)°, and the lower intersections along the vertical transversal include angles labeled (11x-1)° and (2y+5)°. Reasoning: Since (7x+9)° and (7y-4)° are adjacent on a straight line, they form a linear pair, so (7x+9)+(7y-4)=180. This gives 7x+7y+5=180, hence x+y=25. Also, because the lower two oblique lines are parallel and the vertical transversal cuts them, the angles (11x-1)° and (2y+5)° are supplementary same-side angles, so (11x-1)+(2y+5)=180. This gives 11x+2y+4=180, hence 11x+2y=176. Substitute x=25-y into 11x+2y=176: 11(25-y)+2y=176, so 275-11y+2y=176, so 275-9y=176. Therefore -9y=-99 and y=11.
